method: Three sequential local mobile audits using Lighthouse 13.5 and Chrome 155; median performance report retained as lighthouse.json. GPU disabled for headless auditing. All attempts are retained.

warnings: The tested device appears to have a slower CPU than  Lighthouse expects. This can negatively affect your performance score. Learn more about [calibrating an appropriate CPU slowdown multiplier](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/blob/main/docs/throttling.md#cpu-throttling).
